name: Ahrefs
one_liner: SEO data platform offering backlinks, keyword, SERP, rank tracking and site audit data via API v3.
auth_notes: Direct API uses an API key created by workspace owners or admins in Account settings. Third-party apps use OAuth through Ahrefs Connect.
access_notes: API keys are created by workspace owners or admins on eligible paid plans; other plans get limited free test queries. Not enterprise-only: Ahrefs Connect apps reach Lite, Standard, Advanced and Enterprise. Ahrefs Connect needs an application and review before going live. Paid requests cost at least 50 API units.

buildability.rationale: Self-serve API keys on eligible paid plans and a documented API v3. OAuth for third-party apps needs Ahrefs Connect review. The hosted MCP endpoint may not be used for custom programmatic access.

identity.quote: With Ahrefs API, you can use data from your Ahrefs workspace to create custom integrations and automations.

auth.quote: To send requests to Ahrefs API, you'll need an API key.
Users connect their Ahrefs account via OAuth, and your app can fetch data using their API units.

access.quote: Ahrefs API is available on eligible paid plans.
becomes available to users on Ahrefs paid plans (Lite, Standard, Advanced, and Enterprise).

sandbox.quote: We strongly encourage the use of our complimentary test queries for all development and testing purposes

api_surface.quote: Ahrefs API is limited to 60 requests per minute by default.

mcp.quote: Ahrefs provides a hosted MCP server that allows users with a Lite plan or higher to connect their Ahrefs account to supported AI tools.

buildability.quote: Using the external MCP endpoint via custom scripts, bridges, or standalone HTTP/JSON-RPC clients is unsupported and not permitted.
